B · A Sign in button on the card

Example dataDrawn from the console, 2026-11-23

Idea

A "Sign in" button on the card of a plan that needs a sign-in opens its own sheet; Manage carries the same entry ("Replace sign-in") for a healthy plan.

Pros

  • The fix is one press from the list, beside the Sign-in needed chip.
  • The sign-in sheet is short and single-purpose; lends kept are listed in it.

Risks

  • A second control on the card breaks the cards rule of one Manage control (LlmPlans.tsx header comment).
  • A new sheet kind with Back to Manage: one more path to keep in step with Add plan.
  • Two entries (card and Manage) for one action.
